accounting: 2 x 64 development-screen calls; no campaign ledger, no budget
design: Identical frozen controller, identical seed, identical budget. The ONLY difference is the single molecule each run starts from: the live thiothixene leader (0.4839) versus the best target-blind ring graft (0.5076).
reading: The leader start improved by EXACTLY ZERO over 64 calls, which matches the live campaigns sitting near 0.48 for ~1,000 charged calls. The graft start gained +0.0734 under the same controller. So the ring swap's value is not its +0.0237 one-step reward -- it is that it places the search somewhere ordinary COMPOSE edits can make progress. The gap widened from +0.0237 at the graft to +0.0971 after 64 matched calls.
limits: One task, one seed, 64 calls, and a single start molecule per arm. It establishes that THIS graft is a better basin, not that ring swaps generally are.
